LightningComponentBundle.description: This component embeds a Figma prototype. Created by Chris Mendoza

property.name: embedUrl
property.label: Figma Embed URL
property.description: The URL in Figma's Embed UI

property.name: width
property.label: Width
property.description: Width of the embedded content (e.g., 500px or 100%)

property.name: height
property.label: Height
property.description: Height of the embedded content (e.g., 600px or 100%)

property.name: spinnerHexColor
property.label: Spinner Hex Color

property.name: spinnerOpacity
property.label: Spinner Opacity
property.description: Opacity of the spinner background (1 is 100%)
